name: Revision Session Marks
changes: When the settings refuse a Pro choice, for example in Change summary (Pro), the keyboard focus now stays on that setting.
In a text field the focus leaves the field, as before.
tip: Run Show session and baselines to see the saved text and check which draft the baseline belongs to.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Revision Session Marks is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with your writing.
